message.content:
{
  "summary": "Valve FV-101 position does not follow command (rule FV-101.DISC, tag ZT-101) raised at 10:02 with an active position of 34.5%, command of 48.3%, and gap of 13.8. The likely root cause is a stuck valve due to fibre and lint jamming the valve trim, a seized stem, a position transmitter fault, or a loss of instrument air.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Loss of instrument air to the actuator, or a failed positioner.",
    "Fibre and lint jamming the valve trim, or a seized stem.",
    "Position transmitter fault (the valve moves but ZT-101 does not)."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Check the instrument air pressure at the actuator and the positioner output.",
    "Look at the valve stem and position indicator locally and compare them with ZT-101 on the HMI.",
    "Check whether the forward flow FIT-102 changes when the command changes.",
    "Check that the valve position ZT-101 follows the command FV-101.",
    "Check the level locally on the tank gauge."
  ],
  "handover": "Investigated medium discrepancy alarm for valve FV-101 at 10:17 (raised at 10:02, position 34.5 %, command 48.3 %, gap 13.8). Verified local valve stem and position indicator, instrument air pressure, and flow responses per SOP-07 and SOP-11.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-07 7.3",
    "SOP-07 7.2",
    "SOP-07 7.4",
    "SOP-11 11.4"
  ]
}
